messages:
marta: Heads-up — after the RBAC change in service-account perms this morning our SAST run is spamming ~120 new findings on the infra repo. Many look like duplicates or FP. Can we coordinate a quick triage?
ryan: Thanks for flagging. Do you have an example finding id?
marta: here's one copy-pasted from the scanner output (sensitive bits redacted):
```
FILE: infra/k8s/helm/templates/secret.yaml:42
FINDING: hardcoded-credential
DETAILS: possible AWS secret in template. matched pattern: AKIA[REDACTED]
TRACE: Helm values merged from ops/values-staging.yaml
```
ryan: hmm — that value comes from a sealed secret placeholder. The scanner is matching the placeholder token pattern.
sarah: I saw similar noise in yesterday's nightly run after we rotated the KMS key. SealedSecrets changed format. Might be a pattern mismatch.
marta: Exactly. Also we need KMS audit logs to confirm whether those tokens were actually materialized during deploy. Paging @dev-scanner-bot to attach evidence.
dev-scanner-bot: Auto-attach: last scan run id=202634, config=ruleset-v3. Payload: https://scans.internal/202634/report (redacted). Reaction :robot_face:.
ali: Quick checklist proposal: (1) capture sample FP list, (2) bundle helm values + sealedsecret manifest, (3) query KMS decrypt logs for the service-account identity, (4) suppress pattern with a scoped rule if confirmed FP.
marta: +1. I'm starting a thread in the ticket with sample findings. Ryan can you share the helm values snippet you saw?
ryan: paste below (sanitized):
```
# ops/values-staging.yaml
secrets:
  db_password: "sealed:ABCD..."
  aws_access_key: "sealed:AKIA-PLACEHOLDER"
```
sarah: That "sealed:AKIA-PLACEHOLDER" is the new encoding format. Scanner regex still treats AKIA prefix as an AWS key. We should update the detector to only flag when not inside a sealed token.
marta: Agreed. For short-term mitigation: create a suppression rule scoped to infra/* and ruleset-v3 that expires in 7 days while we patch. Make sure to attach evidence bundle and approver.
ali: I'll open the suppression PR for the scanner config and set expiration. Who signs off? @ryan or @sarah?
ryan: I can approve after we add the evidence bundle. Also we should log the RBAC change that triggered more scans — link to the PR?
marta: PR: https://git.internal/rad/infra/pulls/789 (ops:rbac-update) — added a service-account to allow keystore read. That increased helm rendering during CI.
sarah: Also, audit logging note: if we query KMS logs we need the decrypt events from the keystore service-account during the CI window (2026-03-21T09:10Z — 09:18Z). I can run the query if you give me the exact principal id.
marta: principal: svc-ga-ops@redwood.internal.ali: I'll collect the sample finding IDs and upload the evidence tar to the ticket. Also proposing a longer-term rules fix: change the AWS key detector to ignore patterns nested under sealed:* and add a negative lookbehind for 'sealed:' in the regex.
ryan: Regex patch idea: `(?<!sealed:)\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b` — should reduce noise. We should test against the corpus.
sarah: Good. I'll run the scanner locally with the patched regex on the infra repo and post results. If FP drops >95% we can push to ruleset-v4.
marta: Plan summary in case folks jump in later: 1) Ali uploads evidence bundle; 2) Ryan opens suppression PR with expiration and link to evidence; 3) Sarah tests regex patch and posts results; 4) If tests pass, update ruleset and revoke suppression. Also query KMS decrypt logs to prove no cleartext leaked.
dev-scanner-bot: Note: suppression PR template autopopulates with: justification, evidence_url, expires_at, approver=@ryan.
ali: Uploaded evidence bundle to ticket: https://tickets.internal/SEC-1234/attachments/ev-bundle.tar.gz
ryan: Opening suppression PR now. PR link: https://git.internal/scanner-configs/pulls/456
marta: Thanks. One more ask — can we add a one-line entry to the incident playbook about "scan noise after RBAC/keystore changes" so oncall knows to check sealed secret format next time?
sarah: Good idea. I'll add a short note in runbook.md and ping oncall.
marta: Great. I'll mark this thread as actioned once suppression PR merges and KMS logs are attached. :white_check_mark:
ryan: Suppression PR merged.
sarah: Local test: flagged results dropped from 122 -> 3 (manual review confirmed the 3 are real). Pushing ruleset-v4 candidate.
marta: Awesome — closing loop. Thanks everyone.
